name: Tag Group
description: A labelled set of tags for filtering, choosing or removing, with keyboard navigation between them.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the tags. Without one, give it an aria-label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the tags.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error text under the tags.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Lets tags be chosen. Selected tags turn water-tinted and a check draws in.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: The selected tags' ids (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: The tags selected at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the new selection.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a remove button on each tag and enables Delete and Backspace. The tag shrinks and fades first; remove it from your items here.

props.name: items
props.description: The tags' data, rendered by a function child. Each item needs an id, or give each Tag one.

props.name: children
props.description: Tag elements, or a function from an item to a Tag.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Shown in place of the tags when there are none.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Tags that cannot be focused, chosen or removed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TagGroup.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the tag in selections and removals.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Give non-text children a textValue.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon before the label, sized to 14 pixels.

props.name: avatar
props.description: A 20 pixel avatar before the label: an image URL, or your own element.

props.name: tone
props.description: The soft tint, as on Badge. A selected tag is always water.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain-text label for assistive tech and type-ahead, when children are not a string.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables this tag.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Tag.
